applicability: The notes listing behind GET /api/notes/list (list_notes and its walk helpers in mcp/src/agents_remember/serving/notes.py) over one series master's tasks/<repo>/<master>/notes/ root.
conditions: Every request walks the live notes tree from the root.
exclusions: Browser-side caching or polling cadence in the dashboard client.
statement: The notes listing keeps no state between requests, so a note written or grown after one listing appears with its current size in the next one (ICR-R17 live refresh).
